name: worktree-switcher
description: Electron app to checkout git worktrees into the local branch for testing

scripts.dist:install: npm run dist && rm -rf "/Applications/Worktree Switcher.app" && cp -R "dist/Worktree Switcher-$(uname | tr A-Z a-z)-$(node -p process.arch)/Worktree Switcher.app" /Applications/
